source_text: Nam prudens revera ac sapiens in cunctis erat: nec similis ei, ex universis generationibus ulla unquam est reperta. Non sicut antea virgo Eva sola in paradiso chorum agens atque tripudians, relaxata mente per incuriam ab Auctore omnis mali serpente, verbum suscepit; et sic sensu mentis corrupta est, ac per ipsam fraudulentus venenum effundens, mortemque admiscens, in omnem mundum introduxit: ac propterea omnis Sanctorum aerumna nata est: verum in sola sancta Virgine, eius lapsus reparatus est.
thought_title: Mary wise where Eve was careless
orientation: The homilist is speaking just after the angel says the Holy Spirit will come upon Mary, and now compares Mary with Eve.
pass_a_gloss: For truly prudent and wise in all things she was: nor like to her, from out of all generations, any woman ever has been found. Not as before the virgin Eve alone in paradise leading a chorus and dancing, with mind let loose through carelessness by the serpent author of all evil, received a word; and so corrupted in the sense of her mind she was, and through her the deceitful one pouring out poison and mixing in death brought it into the whole world: and for this reason all suffering of the saints was born: but in the holy Virgin alone, her fall was repaired.

choices.why: keeps both verbs physical and joyous, matching paradise scene, not church office
verbum is indefinite and lower case, so not the divine Word but the serpent message

choices.english: the deceitful one pouring out poison
choices.why: fraudulentus is masculine nominative agent distinct from Eve, acting through her
eius looks back to Eve in context, repaired in the Virgin alone

pass_b_english: For in truth she was prudent and wise in everything, and no one like her from all generations has ever been found. She was not like Eve before her, a virgin alone in paradise, leading a chorus and dancing, who with her mind grown lax through carelessness received a word from the serpent, the author of all evil. So Eve was corrupted in the judgment of her mind, and through her the deceitful one, pouring out poison and mixing in death, brought them into the whole world, and for this reason all the suffering of the saints came to be. But in the holy Virgin alone Eve's fall was repaired.
notes: The Latin phrase ab Auctore omnis mali serpente is compressed; the gloss reads serpent and author of all evil together as the agent.

problems.quote: But in the holy Virgin alone her fall was repaired.
problems.source_quote: verum in sola sancta Virgine, eius lapsus reparatus est.
problems.why: 'Her' reads as the Virgin's fall; eius is Eve's lapse.
problems.fix: But in the holy Virgin alone, Eve's fall was repaired.
problems.ruling: Splitting the sentence makes 'her' refer to 'sancta Virgine', misleadingly suggesting Mary's fall; non-reflexive 'eius lapsus' refers to Eve's fall.

edits.old: But in the holy Virgin alone her fall was repaired.
edits.new: But in the holy Virgin alone Eve's fall was repaired.

fixed: Fixed ambiguous 'her': source 'eius lapsus' refers to Eve's fall, not the Virgin's, so changed to Eve's fall.
